style: Small east-facing summit shrine, with dressed hipped roofs and covered court
key_structures: Eastern pilgrim stairs and the road approach
Marble-faced doorway and low twin hipped roofs
Small sanctum with the Shakti Peetha sacred shila
Covered hilltop court and subsidiary shrines
special_features: Relief sculpture documented in the sanctum
Marble panels visible on the sanctum’s eastern façade
materials: Terracotta-toned exterior facing and roof cloth
Metal roofing on the covered court
renovation_history: Ancient sanctum referenced in Padma and Vayu Puranas; structural stone shrine erected around 15th century CE; expanded by local rulers and pilgrimage trusts.
